headline: LAD @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.78 at SDP 2.73, with a projected total of 7.51. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +0.71 runs while SDP moved -0.35, changing the projected margin by +1.06 runs. The projected total climbed +0.35, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shohei Ohtani has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Miguel Andujar, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Dalton Rushing, Sung-Mun Song because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
